title: Docker Base Image Monitor Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Docker Base Image Monitor workflow

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

images.description: List of Docker images to monitor for digest changes

name.description: Friendly name for the image (used in logs and commit messages)

image.description: Docker image name without tag (e.g., 'n8nio/n8n', 'library/postgres'). With 'dockerfile' also the cross-check: the FROM line must use this image ('python', 'library/python' and 'docker.io/library/python' are the same), otherwise the entry is not checked and the job fails at the end.

tag.description: Docker tag to monitor (typically floating tags like 'stable', 'latest'). Required without 'dockerfile'. With 'dockerfile' leave it out: the tag of the FROM line is monitored, and a different value here is reported as stale and ignored.

dockerfile.description: Path of the Dockerfile this image is the base of, relative to the repository root. The monitor then watches the tag of its FROM line - ARG defaults before the first FROM, digest pins (tag@sha256:...) and --platform resolved - so a Dependabot bump of that line moves the monitor with it. One Dockerfile per entry: an image several Dockerfiles build on needs one entry per Dockerfile. Build args given at build time are not seen; the ARG default counts - keep 'tag' instead when the release overrides the FROM line's ARG with --build-arg.

stage.description: Only with 'dockerfile', when it has FROM lines of this image on different tags, or a FROM line whose image or tag cannot be read (an ARG without a default): the stage name (FROM ... AS <stage>, case-insensitive) whose FROM line is monitored. Not needed when all FROM lines of the image use the same tag.

from-index.description: Alternative to 'stage': the FROM line to monitor, counted from 0 as COPY --from=<n> counts stages.

variable.description: GitHub repository variable name to store the digest. One per watched image:tag - entries with 'dockerfile' that share it with an entry on another image:tag are not checked.

commit-prefix.description: Commit message prefix for semantic release compatibility

auto-create-variables.description: Automatically create GitHub variables if they don't exist

images.name: python
images.description: Tag taken from the FROM line of src/app/Dockerfile
